title: Fasteners.
officialText:
Fasteners for asphalt shingles shall be galvanized, stainless steel, aluminum or copper roofing nails,
minimum 12 gage (0.105 inches (2.67 mm)) shank with a minimum ⅜ inch-diameter (9.5 mm) head, of a length to penetrate
through the roofing materials and a minimum of ¾ inch (19.1 mm) into the roof sheathing. Where the roof sheathing is less
than ¾ inch (19.1 mm) thick, the nails shall penetrate through the sheathing. Fasteners shall comply with ASTM F 1667.
